title: Senior Property Manager - US hours
description:
Our client in the US is seeking an experienced Senior Property Manager to take ownership of day-to-day residential and commercial property operations across the portfolio. This role will supervise the Assistant Property Manager, oversee tenants and vendors, manage maintenance and lease administration, and ensure property-related issues are proactively driven through to resolution.
The ideal candidate will exercise strong independent judgment, maintain excellent operational oversight, and significantly reduce the need for ownership to manage routine property matters.
Responsibilities

• Supervise, train, and direct the Assistant Property Manager and other property management resources, establishing accountability for maintenance, tenant matters, leasing, inspections, vendors, open items, and completion dates.

• Manage residential and commercial maintenance from initial report through verified completion, including vendor selection, scheduling, pricing, supervision, quality control, tenant coordination, and documentation.

• Oversee lease administration across the portfolio, including accurate lease records, critical dates, renewal and option periods, rent increases, expirations, notice requirements, and other material lease obligations.

• Maintain and verify recurring tenant charges in Propertyware, including base rent, CAM, property tax, insurance, and other recoverable expenses, coordinating with the Controller to ensure charges are implemented accurately and timely.

• Monitor tenant and landlord lease compliance, including insurance certificates, required notices, maintenance obligations, use restrictions, reporting requirements, and other material lease provisions, and follow exceptions through resolution.

• Maintain a forward looking property management calendar covering lease expirations, renewals, inspections, compliance requirements, vendor contracts, licenses, recurring testing, and other property specific deadlines.

• Review, approve, and when authorized, pay property level bills and vendor invoices. Confirm that work was authorized, completed, reasonably priced, and charged to the correct property, then coordinate with the Controller for reconciliation and financial controls.

• Manage tenant communications, escalations, complaints, notices, leasing, renewals, AIR forms, DocuSign processes, move ins, move outs, delinquency coordination, and operational rent roll information.

• Oversee property inspections, backflow testing, fire protection testing, local licenses, affordable housing requirements, insurance claims, property tax valuation reviews, capital improvements, repairs, construction, and other property specific compliance or operational matters.

• Support CAM reconciliations by interpreting lease requirements, recoverability, allocations, property operations, and supporting documentation, while the Controller owns the accounting calculations and final financial reconciliation.

• Maintain complete and current property records in Dropbox and Propertyware, including leases, amendments, vendor documents, inspections, maintenance records, notices, approvals, correspondence, invoices, and other key records.

Requirements

• Proven experience in property management , ideally across both residential and commercial properties.

• Strong understanding of day-to-day property operations, maintenance coordination, tenant management, leasing, and vendor management.

• Experience supervising or managing property management staff, with the ability to delegate, train, hold others accountable, and follow up on outstanding items.

• Strong knowledge of lease administration and compliance , including renewals, expirations, options, rent increases, notices, and lease obligations.

• Experience managing maintenance and repair projects from initial request through completion and quality control.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple properties, deadlines, vendors, tenants, and operational priorities sim

title: Principal Software Engineer, Developer Acceleration (Release Engineering)
description:
POS-32873

About the Team

HubSpot's Developer Acceleration group empowers over 2,000 engineers to build, test, and deploy their code at scale. The release engineering team owns the full delivery pipeline - from pull request to production - and is responsible for hundreds of thousands of builds per day, including tens of thousands of QA deployments. 

We're in the middle of a fundamental shift. Agentic AI is changing what release engineering can look like - from AI-powered QA agents that evaluate every deploy, to systems that can reason about risk, surface anomalies, and make autonomous decisions in the delivery pipeline. The team is actively building toward this future, and the opportunity for someone who can help shape it is significant.

The team owns and evolves some of the most critical foundational systems inside HubSpot's engineering organization, including build infrastructure, test orchestration, deployment pipelines, and the tooling that underpins incident management and production reliability. This is not a team focused on maintaining existing systems. It is an engineering organization responsible for rethinking how software gets shipped at scale - and what becomes possible when intelligent agents are embedded throughout that process.

About the Role

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to help define the technical future of release engineering at HubSpot - at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and agentic AI.

The role of AI in software delivery is no longer theoretical. We're actively deploying AI agents across our build, test, and deploy pipeline, and we're only at the beginning of understanding what's possible. This is a rare opportunity to work on infrastructure problems that very few engineers have encountered - at a scale that demands novel approaches - while helping to define what AI-native release engineering looks like in practice.

At HubSpot, Principal Engineers are expected to stay close to the code, lead high-impact initiatives end-to-end, and influence technical direction well beyond a single team. This role is for someone who can move between infrastructure architecture, agentic AI systems, and large-scale delivery pipeline design while remaining a hands-on builder throughout

Key Expectations

Own the future of HubSpot's release engineering platform

• Shape the technical direction for the build, test, and deploy systems that underpin how HubSpot ships software.

• Drive architectural decisions across pipeline design, test infrastructure, deployment orchestration, and developer ergonomics.

• Help define what the next generation of HubSpot's delivery platform should look like - not just how to operate the current one.

Be a deeply hands-on, high-leverage builder

• Write production code regularly and lead complex initiatives from idea to rollout.

• Design and implement AI-powered QA agents that run on every deploy, reducing risk and increasing confidence in continuous delivery.

• Turn ambiguous infrastructure problems into simple, scalable systems and clear technical direction.

Rethink testing and delivery infrastructure for a new era

• Challenge 10-year-old assumptions about build systems and deployment pipelines given what's actually possible today.

• Rethink testing infrastructure for a world where software behavior is increasingly non-deterministic.

• Drive the roadmap toward 500+ deploys per minute, identifying and eliminating bottlenecks across the delivery pipeline.

Influence across the broader engineering org

• Partner with engineering leaders to align release engineering direction with what HubSpot needs to build next.

• Work horizontally across teams to guide technical tradeoffs, rationalize configuration and change management across concurrent teams, and raise the architectural bar for platform work.

• Act as a multiplier through design reviews, technical mentoring, and principled decision-making on the most critical systems in the space.

title: Mobile Software Engineer, Growth & Experimentation
description:
Everis has a different standard for talent. We do not use years of experience, titles, or pedigree as substitutes for ability. We look for exceptional work, sound judgment, fast learning, ownership, and evidence of impact. It is not a lower bar. It is a sharper one.

We’re looking for an accomplished software engineer who has built real mobile applications and already has practical exposure to growth, experimentation, conversion optimization, or broader product work. This role requires both engineering depth and evidence that you can think beyond implementation.

Join Everis at a defining stage of growth. Help shape the product, influence the company we become, and grow with us. Work 100% remotely from anywhere, benefit from unlimited leave, and connect with colleagues at company-sponsored international retreats in some of the world’s most inspiring cities.

ABOUT EVERIS

Everis is a growing, remote-first software company founded by proven technology entrepreneurs Rob Rawson and Liam Martin, who previously built Time Doctor into an eight-figure global SaaS business. We acquire promising mobile apps and SaaS companies, invest in their future, and improve their products, technology, and customer experience. Our ambition is to make Everis the best long-term home for exceptional software products-and a company where exceptional people can take real ownership, do consequential work, and grow with us.

ABOUT THE PRODUCT

Pebble is Everis’s growing, speaking-first language-learning app for iOS and Android. It helps people learn English, Spanish, and French through practical lessons, pronunciation practice, and guided conversations that get them speaking from day one. The product is live and evolving quickly, with major opportunities across onboarding, habit formation, activation, retention, conversion, and new markets. Your engineering and product decisions will directly influence how well people learn and how quickly Pebble grows.

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

Most engineering roles begin after the problem, solution, and ticket have already been defined. Here, you join the work earlier. You will remain a software engineer first, but you will also identify product problems, decide what to test, build the solution, measure the outcome, and use the evidence to determine what happens next. This is not a marketing role for someone who codes; it is an engineering role with responsibility for product outcomes.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

- Build, ship, and improve Pebble’s mobile applications.

- Find friction across onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, conversion, and monetization.

- Turn product questions into improvements, prototypes, A/B tests, and other useful experiments.

- Use product and user data to understand behavior and decide what should be built next.

- Define success measures, analyze results, and act on what you learn.

- Work directly with our founders and product and business leadership.

- Balance strong engineering with the speed required to test ideas and learn.

WHAT YOU NEED TO BRING

This is a mobile engineering job first. You need to have built, shipped, and supported a production mobile app. We mean a real product used by real people - not just a demo or code sample.

We also need proof you've thought beyond implementation. Show us at least one of these:

- Breadth beyond implementation. Direct mobile-growth or conversion work You must show meaningful evidence of at least one of the following: growth experimentation, A/B or split testing, conversion optimization, product ownership, building and operating your own software product.

- Conversion optimization. You improved a real flow: onboarding, activation, a paywall, trial-to-paid, checkout, or another point where users dropped.

- Core Stack. Strong engineering fundamentals and sound judgment about reliability, maintainability, quality, and speed. Flutter/Dart, TypeScript/NestJS, MongoDB, or close equivalents; and App Store or Google Play subscriptions

OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own 16 Leadership Principles, and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.

Stream powers chat, video, activity feeds, and moderation for over a billion end users. From Amsterdam to Boulder to Techstars, we've raised over $58.25M to build the best Chat, Video, Feeds, and Moderation infrastructure available, with best-in-class support. We're 120+ people across 35 nationalities, and we've been at this for over a decade.

Our AI Moderation product is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform. Customers use it to detect harmful text, images, video, and audio in real time - configuring policies, harm categories, blocklists, and automated actions, then reviewing what's left in a moderation queue their teams live in every day. When it's tuned well, it protects communities and saves moderators from work no one should have to do. When it's tuned poorly, false positives frustrate good users and real harm slips through. That gap is what this role exists to close.

THE ROLE

You'll own the customer side of Trust & Safety: getting new customers live, keeping their detection accurate as their communities evolve, and making their Trust & Safety teams genuinely good at using the product.

This is a customer-facing role with a hands-on technical edge. You won't be shipping product code, but you will be in the dashboard configuring policies, reading through flagged content to understand why a rule misfired, poking at API responses, and building the reports that show a customer whether their moderation is actually working. You'll be the person a Head of Trust & Safety calls when their false-positive rate spikes - and the person who tells our product and engineering teams what needs to change.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Onboarding and implementation

- Run moderation onboarding end-to-end: kickoff, policy design, configuration, testing, and go-live for new customers.

Continuous improvement and tuning

- Own ongoing tuning: review flagged and missed content, diagnose false positives and false negatives, and adjust configuration to improve precision and recall.

- Investigate escalations when moderation behaves unexpectedly, and drive them to root cause with our engineering team.

- Turn patterns across accounts into product feedback, and advocate internally for the changes that would fix them at the source.

Customer enablement

- Train moderators and T&S leads on the review queue, dashboard, rule builder, and reporting - and make them fast in it.

- Build the enablement layer this function needs: onboarding playbooks, configuration templates by vertical, best-practice guides, tuning checklists, internal runbooks.

- Support renewals and expansion by making the value of the product visible: business reviews, usage narratives, and outcomes tied to the customer's own goals.

Cross-functional work

- Work closely with Sales and Solutions Engineering on late-stage deals, pilots, and proof-of-concepts where implementation reality matters.

- Feed the product roadmap with prioritized, evidence-backed customer needs.

- Help scale the function as the customer base grows - including documenting what you do so the next hires ramp faster than you did.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 3+ years in a customer-facing role at a technical or SaaS company - customer success, implementation, solutions consulting, technical account management, professional services, or Trust & Safety operations with external stakeholders.

- Comfortable being technical without being an engineer

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Compute Production team builds the data foundations and internal products that let Fluidstack bring gigawatt-scale AI compute online and keep it running.

- Drive technical tradeoffs with engineers and ship end to end, from problem definition through delivery

- Run direct discovery with compute production stakeholders to understand their domain, then validate that what you built actually changes how they work

- Define and track the metrics that prove the product is delivering real leverage, and cut or redirect work that isn't

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow revenue, and pursue new business opportunities.

Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet. There is significant work ahead, and an opportunity to help make the global economy more accessible while doing meaningful work.

About the team

The Radar team helps businesses manage and reduce payment fraud. Radar combines machine learning, risk signals, configurable controls, and fraud analytics to help businesses make informed decisions about payments while managing the balance between fraud prevention and revenue growth.

The Radar sales team works with businesses to understand their fraud challenges, improve payment performance, and adopt the products and services that best support their goals. • Help customers understand the tradeoffs between fraud prevention, payment performance, conversion, and operational complexity.

• Use customer feedback and market insight to inform product priorities, positioning, enablement, and go-to-market plans.

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. You also own the deployment process that gets those adapted models onto edge targets repeatably.

This is not a research role and not a cloud-serving role. It is applied ML for edge deployment. It is a great fit for a senior engineer who has already shipped models to non-GPU or edge hardware and wants to do it across many platforms, or a staff-level engineer who wants to define how Deepgram ports speech models to new hardware. description:
About the Project

Project Hydrus is a scripted and conversational audio data collection project. The recordings produced help build natural, everyday-sounding synthesized voices for conversational AI products - voices that sound like real people talking, not scripted performances.

As Session Director, you'll lead live recording sessions with Voice Contributors, guiding them through scripted scenarios to produce natural, conversational-quality audio. This hands-on role blends creative direction, coaching, and technical audio judgment - making scripted material sound authentic and unscripted, rather than recited, while keeping sessions moving at a natural pace.

What You'll Do

• Direct voice performers through scripted scenarios, coaching for natural, conversational delivery rather than verbatim recitation.

• Build quick scene context for performers (who, where, why) and improvise to fill narrative or dialogue gaps live, keeping sessions flowing naturally.

• Adapt scripted wording for natural phrasing and regional/dialect authenticity as needed.

• Monitor and correct technical audio quality in real time: mic technique, pacing, clarity, and background noise.

• Manage session pacing to meet recording targets without sacrificing performance quality, and maintain organized notes on adjustments and retakes.

• Create a supportive, low-pressure environment for performers, including those with limited prior voice experience.

What We're Looking For

Required

• Native fluency in the required language (with specific dialect), with a strong ear for natural, colloquial phrasing.

• Experience directing, coaching, or producing voice or audio talent (e.g., voice direction, casting direction, audio/podcast production, dubbing/ADR, or theater direction).

• Demonstrated ability to give clear, specific, actionable performance direction.

• Strong working knowledge of basic recording/mic technique (proximity, plosives, room noise, levels).

• Comfortable improvising and adjusting scripted material on the spot.

• Excellent interpersonal skills; able to build rapport quickly with performers of varying experience levels.

Preferred (nice to have, not required)

• Background in improv, theater direction, or acting coaching.

• Experience directing non-professional or first-time voice talent specifically.

• Familiarity with DAWs or recording software (e.g., Pro Tools, Adobe Audition, Reaper) for spot-checking audio quality.

Commitment & Compensation

• Estimated time: Approximately 8 hours calibration, plus supervision across two recording sessions of ~4 hours each per participant

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. What is The Role

We are seeking a visionary and execution-focused Senior Director of Enterprise Data to lead the transformation and maturity of our data ecosystem. Having recently scaled to $2 billion in annual revenue , we are actively building the infrastructure, governance, and operational models required to sustain our trajectory to $4 billion and beyond .

In this role, reporting to the CIO, you will own the end-to-end data strategy, evolving our data platform architecture, scaling our Master Data Management (MDM) systems into an active operational hub, and institutionalizing federated data governance. You will bridge the gap between complex engineering and business execution, transforming data from a utility into a high-octane product that powers real-time decision-making, predictive analytics, agentic AI and operational efficiency across the global enterprise.

What You Will Be Doing

Data Strategy & Platform Evolution

• Architect the Future: Design, execute, and evolve a scalable data platform roadmap capable of handling a multi-billion dollar enterprise’s volume, velocity, and variety of data.

• De-bottleneck Legacy Infrastructure: Transition our centralized pipelines into a modern, decoupled data architecture.

• Data as a Product: Implement a "Data as a Product" mindset across engineering teams, ensuring datasets have strict Service Level Objectives (SLOs), rigorous uptime, and high catalog discoverability.

• Streaming & Real-Time Analytics: Drive the evolution from purely batch-oriented processing to real-time event streaming for critical business domains like Engineering, Finance, and Customer Experience.

Enterprise Master Data Management (MDM)

title: Vice President – Food Testing Laboratory Operations (WISEcode Labs)
description:
This role is for a position at WISEcode labs, WISEcode's sister company. 
--
WISEcode Labs, formerly Beaconpoint Labs, was built out of necessity.
The laboratory was created to support its sister company WISEcode and its Food Genome Project™, an ambitious
effort to build a comprehensive food and ingredient intelligence platform. In pursuing that goal, it became clear that
the required testing capabilities simply did not exist. No laboratory could reliably deliver the breadth, depth, speed,
and transparency needed to analyze thousands of ingredients across hundreds of analytes with confidence. Rather
than compromise, the lab was built to solve that problem properly.
WISEcode Labs is an independent third-party testing laboratory serving food, beverage, dietary supplement,
ingredient, and adjacent consumer-health companies. The lab combines advanced analytical instrumentation,
rigorous method development, microbiology and chemistry expertise, and a high-touch service model designed for
customers with complex and recurring testing needs.
WISEcode Labs is differentiated by its unwavering focus on food safety and nutrition testing and becoming a primary
testing partner to key customers, owing to its rapid response time and direct access to scientific leaders, customized
solutions, and defensible data.
Effective August 25th 2026, the company unified its brand with its sister company under a single name: WISEcode
Labs. The next phase is to scale this platform without losing the quality, speed, independence, confidentiality, and
accountability on which the business was built to be the preferred testing & scientific partner for the food industry and
WISEcode’s mission towards food transparency.

We are seeking a GPU Systems Engineer with deep expertise in CUDA programming, GPU architecture, and high-performance computing to design and optimize compute-intensive workloads on modern accelerator hardware. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. • Experience integrating custom kernels into ML frameworks.

title: Software Engineer - Onboard Maps and State Estimation
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Localization, Calibration, and Mapping team delivers high-integrity solutions that let autonomous systems navigate with precision in real-time, safety-critical environments - across consumer automotive, trucking, mining, and construction. As a new team focused on platformization, we offer a rare opportunity to own core work leveraged across the entire organization.

HD maps go stale the moment they're built - lanes get repainted, stop lines move, roads close. You'll own the live map on Applied's onboard stack: a real-time fused estimate of the world built from map priors and live perception, from the estimation core to the change-detection and trust semantics the planner consumes, across every vehicle vertical we serve. This layer is early and has no incumbent design. You'll set the architecture and define the interfaces rather than tune inside someone else's system. We encourage engineers to take ownership of technical and product decisions and to interact closely with users to collect feedback.

 

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

- Own the onboard live-map estimator end to end: fuse HD map priors with live perception into a single, real-time estimate of the world the rest of the stack can trust

- Build our onboard map change detection: classify situations like boundary shifts, stop-line moves, and road closures from the divergence between map and perception, and define when the planner should stop trusting the map

- Define the map trust contracts the planner builds against: confidence semantics, degraded-mode behavior, and the operating points that hold across vehicle programs

- Build the evaluation backbone, ground-truth and metrics pipelines, operating points, and regression testing that keep estimator and detector quality from silently drifting

- Ship estimation code in modern C++ that meets real-time budgets on embedded compute

- Extend the loop offboard over time: aggregate divergence detections across fleet drive logs into map freshness and correction pipelines

 

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

- 5+ years building production software, including at least one shipped system where they owned the estimation core

- State estimation fundamentals proven in production: factor graphs and/or filtering, data association, uncertainty representation and propagation, and 3D geometry and transforms

- Experience fusing heterogeneous sources such as prior map data, perception output, and raw sensors, into a single world estimate, with rigorous error characterization

- Strong modern C++ and the ability to make estimation code meet real-time budgets on e
